   **Bugs and stability.**
      4 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Aug 2, 2026 - Nov 9, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Will Robbins_, Nov 5, 2026, 1/5: "Unfortunately since the latest update, the Android app keeps crashing just after opening. No amount of reinstalling or cache clearing changes this. Please can you assist."
            2. _Theodore B_, Nov 2, 2026, 1/5: "used to be a good app but between the constant bugs, crashes, and now forced AI/subscription nonsense, it's useless."
            3. _Michi S_, Oct 21, 2026, 1/5: "I've been using the app since 2015. But the bugs are piling up and the UX is just going downhill. Just snot. New subscriptions again last year (I was still able to keep my old one). The starter plan seems to be exactly the "intermediate solution" that I wanted since bending spoons' subscriptions, but not for €80 but maybe €30. Now you have 1000 notes instead of 150k, 20 notebooks instead of 2k. I don't need AI. It's not even 1% of the old one and it's €80 instead of €100. Great. 😑 Will switch to Obsidian or Upnote."
